title: A little hello
hint: Tap the middle path once to turn it. Then press Go!

title: Around the corner
hint: Corner tiles connect two neighbouring sides. Turn the bend toward home.

title: A path to the sky
hint: Match both sides of every connection, all the way to the cottage.

title: The scenic route
hint: Bunny follows the path, not the shortest distance. Take the long way home.

title: A bigger meadow
hint: More room to wander. Start near Bunny and connect one tile at a time.

title: A few distractions
hint: Some paths are just distractions. Only the route from Bunny to home matters.

title: Across the garden
hint: Follow the openings carefully. Nearby paths do not connect unless their edges match.

title: The winding way
hint: Turn by turn, make one continuous trail. Undo is here if you change your mind.

title: A loop around
hint: A path can travel around the meadow. Check each corner before you send Bunny.

title: Home, sweet home
hint: Your last tutorial brings the bends together. Take your time—there is no timer.
